requirements.summary: FLEET-CORE: FederationCoordinator/NodeCapabilityRegistry/HeartbeatManager/TaskAssignmentRouter/CheckpointTransfer/NodeRecoveryManager 模块（确定性）
FLEET-TWO-NODE-RUN: ≥2 真实/独立进程 Node 联队执行；Node-B 运行中掉线 Fleet 不崩；无关任务继续；可恢复任务从 checkpoint 转移/重调度
FLEET-HETEROGENEOUS-PROTOCOL: 平台无关核心协议 + Node adapter（目标平台 Windows/Linux/macOS/Android/iOS/HarmonyOS），Fleet 核心无 Windows-only 假设
NETWORK-CAPABILITY-PROBE: per-node direct/system proxy/user proxy/regional proxy/provider proxy 检测 → route 报告
PROXY-ROUTE-POLICY: per task×provider×node 路由、direct 优先；proxy 失败→direct/alternate/migrate/degrade；Proxy 失败不停止 Boss；proxied+direct 共存
KB-SHARED-SPACE: 用户级共享 Knowledge Space，多 Node 贡献/检索同空间，运行时只取所需子集
KB-LOCAL-FALLBACK: KB 后端故障→本地缓存/索引→不依赖缺失知识的任务继续→记录 deferred sync；KB down ≠ Boss down
KB-DEFERRED-SYNC: 离线期间 task results/artifacts/decisions/knowledge candidates 在恢复后可同步
ARTIFACT-BACKBONE: manifest/hash/version/provenance/decision-log/failed-runs/checkpoint relation；部分失败不丢 artifact；archive 布局 99_cache 等；hash/version 供 Fleet/self-iteration/KB 使用
RESEARCH-RP-CONTRACT: RP 正式持久化；Research Contract 定义 question/hypotheses/claims/evidence requirements/experiment plan/evaluation/citation policy/section contract/acceptance gates；paper 从 contract 展开
RESEARCH-SUFFICIENCY-GATE: final 前检查 evidence/claims/experiment/citation/section/review/criticism；禁止页数硬编码替代
RESEARCH-CROSS-REVIEW-LOOP: Method/Evidence/Claim/Writing/Repro/Meta 角色；review→rebuttal→revision→re-review→meta-review→final audit→compile 生产链；结构化 objection+response
RESEARCH-PUBLICATION-MODE: SMOKE/ACCEPTANCE 快速模式保留 + RESEARCH/PUBLICATION 模式启用；不破坏既有 smoke acceptance
RESEARCH-ARCHIVE: final+中间产物按 stage 归档（含 failed-runs），单 stage 失败不清空 run
SELF-ITERATION-INTEGRATION: 候选/影子 与 Main/Verifier 接入项目执行生命周期；worker 只能返回 MODEL_DONE/PARTIAL/FAILED/BLOCKED 且被 Acceptance Gate 拦截 GLOBAL_COMPLETE 误报
SOAK->2H: 单次连续 autonomous run >2h（含 slowdown/retry/checkpoint/degradation/continuation）；多短 run 累计不得替代
UI-ISOLATION: UI crash 后 background controller/workers 继续、UI 可重连恢复状态（架构 + 确定性 battery + smoke）
UI-STATUS-DISPLAY: Owner UI 显示 overall/module/node/provider/task/degraded/blocked/recovery/acceptance-gaps；局部失败≠整个任务失败
SCENARIO-E-COMPILE-FAIL: paper compile 失败→source/evidence/reviews 保留→repair/alternate compile→run 不丢弃（确定性 + 可编译路径）
SCENARIO-G-COMPOSITE: provider FAILED + node OFFLINE + KB DEGRADED + research REWORK 组合下 Boss 继续可执行工作（真实模块 battery）
FINAL-ACCEPTANCE-REPORT: 从 requirement-manifest 生成 Acceptance Report（状态只允许 PASS/LOCKED_PASS/BLOCKED_EXTERNAL/FAILED_WITH_EVIDENCE）
